Definition: from G1909 and ἀθροίζω (to assemble); to accumulate:--gather thick together.
BiblicalUsage: Epathroizo means to gather thick together, to crowd in. Luke uses it once, when the people were gathered thick together to hear Jesus, and He began to speak about this evil generation seeking a sign.
TheologicalSignificance: The crowd's pressing in shows how hungry people were to hear Jesus, and how He refused to give them a sign on demand.
